limitations: The diffusion coefficient, emitted amount, signal identity, and receiver size are synthetic software-test parameters and are not pulmonary physiological evidence.

The analytical solution assumes instantaneous point release, constant isotropic diffusion in unbounded three-dimensional space, a passive small receiver, and optional homogeneous first-order degradation.
Blood flow, advection, vessel walls, alveolar geometry, heterogeneous media, binding, reactions, stochastic counting noise, intersymbol interference, and receiver detection thresholds are absent.
The equivalent capillary diameter only bounds a local contract case; it does not turn the M4.7 equivalent-tube network into microscopic alveolar anatomy.
No external simulator is executed in M4.8; N3Sim or another licensable adapter remains an independent comparison increment.
